cases.title: Valid design (mux + counter)
cases.expected_behavior: Compiles without errors. No latch, no multiple drivers, no warnings about the design.

cases.title: Syntax error (missing semicolon)
cases.expected_behavior: Icarus Verilog reports a syntax error near line 4-5. Yosys fails to parse the file as well.

cases.title: Unintended latch
cases.expected_behavior: Compiles, but Yosys prints 'Latch inferred for signal q'.

cases.title: Multiple drivers
cases.expected_behavior: Compiles in Icarus Verilog (it resolves the conflict), but Yosys 'check' reports multiple conflicting drivers for y.

cases.title: Incorrect combinational assignment (bad sensitivity list)
cases.expected_behavior: Compiles and synthesises without errors. The incomplete sensitivity list is a heuristic finding; the testbench prints FAIL because y does not follow b when sel=1.
